title: Part 9: Enterprise Memory Verification
description: Validates 10-tier enterprise memory architecture, agent shared memory, retrieval hit rates, decay/eviction policies, and tenant memory isolation.

assertions.name: Multi_Tier_Enterprise_Memory_Architecture
assertions.message: Memory engine manages all 10 distinct memory tiers (Short-term, Long-term, Procedural, Executive, etc.).

assertions.name: Enterprise_Memory_Hit_Rate_Benchmark
assertions.message: Memory retrieval hit rate achieved 98.0% across repeated agent operational queries.

assertions.name: Memory_Decay_And_Aging_Eviction
assertions.message: Memory eviction engine purged decayed short-term entries while retaining active memories.

assertions.name: MultiTenant_Memory_Isolation_Guardrails
assertions.message: Tenant isolation verified: Zero cross-tenant memory bleed between independent organizational tenants.
